data.name: Dalbir
data.long_meaning: The name Dalbir is derived from Sanskrit. It is a compound of two words: Dal and Bir. Dal means servant or devoted, and Bir means dharma or righteousness. Thus, Dalbir can be translated as 'Servant of Dharma'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu tradition and is considered to be a strong and meaningful name for a baby boy.
